steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply an RFQ template so the product sheet and attachment flow are available.
Add the requested product search target with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for publishing.
Upload the first available supported document fixture.
Upload a second available supported document fixture.
Add one QA vendor so the event can be published and its vendor view inspected.
Confirm publishing reached the project page.
Check the project page exposes the expected two-attachment count label.
Inspect the event from the invited vendor portal.
Open the published event overview in the vendor portal.
